items.statement: Determine whether initial electron removal and subsequent benzylic hydrogen loss give the same or different mechanistic predictions across para-H, para-Cl, para-Me, para-OMe and para-SMe benzyl alcohols. Establish which trends are supported by molecular electronic energies and spin localization, and test whether a single descriptor is sufficient. This is a bounded molecular hypothesis test, not a calculation of catalytic yield.
items.expected: The conclusion follows the complete same-object control matrix, evaluated hypotheses and demonstrated sensitivity. Accept support, refutation or bounded ambiguity when justified by real results; do not force the author claim. A missing expanded calculation is a missing endpoint, not computed ambiguity. Numerical publication anchors apply only to like-defined source baselines and never substitute for new reference calculations. Avoid these scientific errors: Replacing benzylic H loss by deprotonation, wrong charge/spin or a rearranged channel; mixing G/ZPE into D_e; treating gas-phase ionization as an absolute electrode potential; inferring a full catalytic mechanism from descriptors.
